title: Booking — shared definitions for the vtc/booking/* spec family
description:
A Verifiable Trust Community's booking pages (VTI Community Booking Pages chapter, VTI-BKG-*): a member's page where others book time with them. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

A BOOKING IS AN EVENT. Booking a slot creates an unlisted meeting event in the community (vtc/events/*), with a hidden roster, the host as its host and the booker registered on it (VTI-BKG-050); access details, receipts, reminders and changes are the event's.

TIERS ARE PROVEN, NEVER ASSERTED. A booker is placed in the most trusted tier — `members`, `known`, `guests` — that they prove (VTI-BKG-031).

BUSY TIME IS NEVER DISCLOSED. The host's agent supplies merged, quarter-hour-widened busy intervals (vtc/booking/busy/put); nobody is told why a slot is not offered (VTI-BKG-040, 041).

BookingPageId.title: BookingPageId
BookingPageId.description: Opaque identifier of a booking page: `bkp_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BKG-001).

BookingId.title: BookingId
BookingId.description: Opaque identifier of one booking: `bkg_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters.

BookingMeetingTypeId.title: BookingMeetingTypeId
BookingMeetingTypeId.description: A meeting type's key within its page.

BookingTier.title: BookingTier
BookingTier.description: Who a rule is for (VTI-BKG-030). `members`: active members of the community. `known`: parties the community knows without their being members — a partner community's member proving it by credential, or a party with a relationship in force. `guests`: any party identified by its own identifier.

BookingWeekday.title: BookingWeekday
BookingWeekday.description: A day of the week (iCalendar's MO … SU, spelled out).

BookingLocalTime.title: BookingLocalTime
BookingLocalTime.description: A local time of day, `HH:MM`, read in the page's time zone.

BookingTimeRange.title: BookingTimeRange
BookingTimeRange.description: A span of local time within one day; `endTime` after `startTime`.

BookingWeeklyWindow.title: BookingWeeklyWindow
BookingWeeklyWindow.description: Time offered every week on one day (RFC 7953's AVAILABLE with a weekly rule).

BookingException.title: BookingException
BookingException.description: A dated exception that overrides the weekly windows on its date (VTI-BKG-020): `ranges` replaces that day's time; an empty `ranges` takes the whole day off.

ranges.description: The time offered on that date; empty means none.

BookingAvailability.title: BookingAvailability
BookingAvailability.description: When a page offers time (VTI-BKG-020): weekly windows of local time in `timeZone`, with dated exceptions.

exceptions.description: Dated exceptions; at most one per date.

BookingLimit.title: BookingLimit
BookingLimit.description: At most `count` bookings by one booker in any `periodDays` days (VTI-BKG-021).

BookingTierRule.title: BookingTierRule
BookingTierRule.description: What one tier may book of a meeting type (VTI-BKG-030). A tier with no rule on a meeting type may not book it.

availability.description: The windows this tier is offered, within the page's. Absent: the page's.

minimumNoticeMinutes.description: How long before a slot this tier may still book, reschedule or cancel. Absent: the meeting type's.

approvalRequired.description: Bookings by this tier wait for the host (`pending`). Absent: false, except for `guests`, where absent means true (VTI-BKG-032).

audience.description: `members` only: narrows the tier by the language of an event's audience (VTI-EVT-020).

partners.description: `known` only: the partner communities whose members, proving it by credential, are in the tier.

relationships.description: `known` only: parties with a relationship in force with the community are in the tier. Absent: false.

BookingMeetingType.title: BookingMeetingType
BookingMeetingType.description: One kind of meeting a page offers (VTI-BKG-010).

place.description: Where it happens; released only to the parties of an accepted booking (VTI-EVT-060). Shown to the host only on the page.

questions.description: Questions a booker answers; read by the host only (VTI-BKG-011).

minimumNoticeMinutes.description: The least notice for a booking. Absent: 0.

horizonDays.description: Nothing is offered further ahead. Absent: 60.

dailyCap.description: The most bookings of this type on one local day.

tiers.description: One rule per tier that may book it.

BookingPage.title: BookingPage
BookingPage.description: A booking page as the caller may see it (VTI-BKG-001). A booker sees the meeting types their tier may book, without places, buffers' reasons or other tiers' rules; the host sees all of it.

link.description: The page's link (VTI-BKG-004), an `https` trigger link.

busySuppliedAt.description: Host only: when the host's agent last supplied busy time.

BookingSlot.title: BookingSlot
BookingSlot.description: A free slot: an instant it starts and one it ends.

BookingBusyInterval.title: BookingBusyInterval
BookingBusyInterval.description: One busy interval the host's agent supplies: merged, starting and ending on a quarter hour, nothing else (VTI-CAL-061, VTI-BKG-040).

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: One booking (VTI-BKG-050): the slot, the tier the booker proved, and the event it is. The booker and the host read it; `answers` the host only.

bookerEntryId.description: A member booker's directory entry. Exactly one of this and `bookerDid`.

bookerDid.description: A booker who is not a member, by their identifier.
